newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler ups prices of base '97 Sebring.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler ups prices of base '97 Sebring.

text.p: Chrysler Corp on Friday said the base price of its 1997-model Sebring LX coupe will start at $16,540, a slight increase over the $16,441 it charged for the previous model.
The price of a new Dodge Avenger, the sister car to the Sebring, will start at $14,620, a four percent hike from $14,040 a year ago.
Prices do not include destination charges of $535. Both cars have cash rebates of $500.
The 1997 Sebring LXi is now $21,020, up from $20,150. New Sebring models contain essentially the same equipment as previous models, although anti-lock brakes are no longer standard on the LX version.

The Avenger ES starting price fell $631, or three percent, to $17,490. The ES now comes with a standard four-cylinder, 2.0-liter engine instead of the 2.5-liter V6 in the 1996 model. Also standard on the ES is manual transmission instead of the previous automatic transmission.
New Sebring models feature a new grille and redesigned front and rear exteriors.
Avenger models will have more aggressive styling in the front and rear.
